reviews.text:
Very clean and functional.
The owner is friendly and helpful.

We had a great time!
I brought my little dog (a spinon-type) with a lot of knots. She was washed and groomed beautifully, and I'll definitely come back to you next time. Congratulations, you're very talented.
Dear. Lagotto clipping cost €65 and the hair in the ears is still there.
A truly practical, convenient, and high-quality service! The option of self-service dog washing is a real convenience!
Very comfortable and well-equipped. I think it's a great option if you want to wash your dog yourself.
I highly recommend this place for the impeccable result achieved.
After visiting several grooming centers, I finally found the right place for my puppies: professional, friendly, and very good at grooming Poodles.

Expertise and professionalism at the highest level!
I brought my two-year-old Siberian Husky, Yuko.
The owner, Matteo, is a true animal lover, capable of handling even the most mischievous animals with expertise.
I was amazed by the patience and kindness of the staff.
Excellent value for money, highly recommended!!!

A serious and highly technically skilled professional, even for dogs with unique coats like the Maltese. The center treats animals with empathy, kindness, and care. In 10 years, we've never had a problem. Highly recommended!

First time, 6 months ago, excellent grooming result. Then it went downhill, the last time, 2 weeks ago, horrible cut, if I had done it blindfolded, it would have come out better!!! No symmetry in the cut, neglected parts, not taken care of in the cut itself. Wash, left a lot to be desired. Contacted the owner, he simply said, "You can also not come anymore, if you don't like my work" in the meantime they take the money, the result, is optional!!! NEVER AGAIN!!!

I brought my long-haired, tangled Maltese. He quickly washed and groomed my dog ​​excellently. I've tried many groomers, and this is the best in Milan.
I'll definitely be back. 5 stars.

Dog grooming, both do-it-yourself and professional. The self-service option offers two stalls, each equipped with a tub (with shampoo and conditioner dispensers) and an area for drying and vacuuming hair. It works by inserting a card that recharges based on your needs and the size of your dog. It's convenient because it's open 24/7. The only downside is that the car wash stall isn't always as clean as expected, depending on how it was left by the previous customer. There's also no bathroom, so if you need anything, you'll have to go to the café next door.

Holly is already a beauty, but when she leaves Washdog, she's even more so! 🤩
Matteo is brilliant, professional and competent; we always trust him.
He knows how to handle the Maltipoo's complex coat and offers advice on grooming and grooming.
He's patient and loving with the dogs, and he does his job with passion!

Finally, a groomer who truly knows how to strip my wire-haired dog. After several failed attempts elsewhere, here the work is always precise, clean, and done with care. The dog is always treated well, and the results are always top-notch! The dog is beautiful, well-groomed, and smells great. Friendliness, kindness, and professionalism are the hallmarks. Highly recommended.

Matteo is an exceptional and kind host. You can bathe your four-legged friends independently in two separate, easily accessible stalls using a rechargeable card, or you can leave them in Matteo's loving care. He'll have them back clean and smelling fresh in about an hour. Ozone washing is available; appointments are essential. Highly recommended.
Great self-service dog bath
A very positive experience. Matteo is extremely helpful and professional. A must-have for both self-service and professional grooming. Highly recommended!

I've been a customer for years, and Matteo is always a guarantee: polite, helpful, and loved by my dog! The shop is clean and well-kept, and my Doberman comes out looking dazzling and smelling amazing.
Fair prices and always impeccable service, both the wash done by Matteo and the option to use the two self-service tubs!
Highly recommended!
Optimal
well-stocked, very kind in giving you advice and super efficient

After Lilly, today it was Rufio's turn, who needed a good makeover: the result was amazing! 🐶🐶😍😍. He received so many compliments from those who saw him😎

This year too, our Lilly came out looking beautiful! Well done! Always very friendly, reliable, and truly professional. The location is clean, tidy, and welcoming for our furry friends. We couldn't go anywhere else!

I had the opportunity to take Rocco, my Rottweiler, with me. Although he was a bit stiff at first, Matteo, a true professional, managed to get him under control, bringing him back to me clean and shiny. Highly recommended.
Every time I bring my dog, she comes out as good as new, effective and professional, I recommend it

Teo is excellent at grooming both long-haired and short-haired dogs. I've been going to him exclusively for years—I used to have a cocker spaniel, now two greyhounds—and one important thing is that he knows how to approach dogs; even the most fearful ones are safe in his hands.
Professional, punctual, and affectionate.

After many disappointing experiences, I finally found the right place for Mia, my anxious dog who had never been truly washed without stressing her.
Matteo was exceptional: patient and very professional. She immediately felt at ease with him and left with her fur super soft, shiny, and smelling fresh.
The environment is clean and tidy, and I also appreciated the advice he gave us to follow at home.
We'll always be back! 🐾

The staff is competent, friendly, and helpful, demonstrating a true love for animals. The results are always excellent: clean, fragrant, and well-groomed dogs, a testament to high-quality care. I highly recommend this service for its professionalism and impeccable results.

Taking my 6-year-old Great Dane, Rocco, to Wash Dog on Viale Fulvio Testi is always a pleasure, but what really makes this place special is Matteo, the owner. He's extremely kind, helpful, and passionate about his work. He always welcomes you with a genuine smile and immediately puts both us, the customers, and our four-legged friends, at ease.

The place is spotless, organized, and meticulously maintained, with modern equipment and perfect spaces for washing dogs in complete comfort and safety. Matteo is always ready to lend a hand, offering helpful advice and attentive, professional assistance, demonstrating every time how much he truly cares about the animals' well-being.

A place run with love, where you can feel the love and dedication.
Congratulations, Matteo: your work is a guarantee, and your kindness makes all the difference!
We will definitely be back, and with enthusiasm. 🐶💙
Matteo is a true expert. My long-haired Debora is crazy about him. Thank you, Matteo ❤️
Thanks to Matteo who was super nice in clipping my 20 year old Poodle Giulia, even if she scratched a bit 💦💦 …
Matteo is serious, helpful, and very good. My furry friend is treated like a king. Highly recommended.
Excellent grooming and self-service service! Highly recommended!
Really good 👏🏻. I recommend it 100%. …
Nice place. Clean and well thought out. Thanks Vittorio! Also open on Sundays with a membership card.
Our crash comes out of here ready for a parade! Thorough washing and patience with the dogs.
Well done
Friendly owners

Wash Dog is located in the Bicocca area, just steps from Parco Nord, and that's already a great thing.
The owner is a treasure, always available and professional.
It's open 24/7 if you have a card (you can get one during staff hours and days and recharge it at the totem located inside the shop).
Upon entering, you'll find two stalls with tubs and everything you need to wash and dry your dog.
The showers dispense high-quality water, shampoo, and conditioner.
A minimum amount of cleaning is required upon exiting the stall to allow those who come after to enjoy the service as well.
You can also request grooming services, the new OxyDry service, and use of the washer-dryer. There's a dispenser with various products, and you can purchase coats and accessories.

We went yesterday to give our Yuki a bath. We used the self-service option. The owner was there. He was very helpful and friendly. The facility is well-organized and clean. Shampoo and conditioner are dispensed directly from the shower head while you wash your baby. We found all the comforts, and by activating the card, we can come back whenever we need it. I highly recommend it!!!
Yuki is super happy 🤩🤩🤩
I took the Maltese for a wash and a haircut. When I picked him up, I was enchanted. He was beautiful.
Great place and always clean. Matteo is kind and helpful.
